purpose: Govern gsscph.com visual character, motion, content security, page cohesion, and Squarespace integration.
human_note: The website is a flagship credibility artifact: an editorial journal on the web.

visual.layout: Editorial columns and consistent grid; source master determines bleed behavior.
visual.assets: Preserve original CSS-variable/base64 strategy where present.

motion.current_authoritative_home_behavior: Static Premium: all substantive content visible on load; only a load-time hero cascade plus restrained hover states.
motion.scroll_triggered_motion: Disabled in the current authoritative home master.
motion.source_master_rule: Do not reintroduce IntersectionObserver, scroll-linked reveal machinery, or hidden-on-load content unless the user explicitly creates a new versioned master.

pages.cohesion: Share typography, color, spacing, motion and asset treatment.

implementation.css: Global shared system plus page-scoped or in-block CSS for conflict-prone components.
implementation.backup: Back up live code before replacement; verify before deleting backup.

failure_modes: scroll-reveal doctrine applied to the v2.6 Static Premium home master
v2.5 home restored without explicit rollback instruction
